item.somnium.waking_bell.tooltip: Goes into dreams with you. Use it there to wake up
somnium.dream.drowning_city.objective: Reach the bell atop the sunken cathedral before the water swallows the city.
somnium.dream.shadow_forest.objective: Follow the will-o'-wisps to the Beacon Tree and stand in its light for 5 seconds. The whispers will tell you to turn around. Don't.
somnium.dream.mirror_wastes.objective: Catch your reflection by touching the fleeing mirror 3 times. Your Double follows you and gets faster after every touch.
somnium.dream.collapsing_mine.objective: Find the door out of the maze. The Exit Compass points to it. The mine helps you: sometimes a wall behind you collapses and opens a shorter way.
somnium.dream.crimson_feast.objective: The judges will serve 5 dishes. Eat the fresh ones. Burn the spoiled ones (green name, smoke): dish in one hand, lighter in the other, right-click. Then drink the Toast Goblet.
somnium.dream.void_of_eyes.objective: Reach the Door of Waking, or catch 5 gazes: stare into a Watcher's eyes for 3 seconds and it burns away.
somnium.dream.dream_within_dream: Dream: A Dream Within a Dream
somnium.dream.falling_planks.objective: Climb the stairs. Flights collapse behind you and cracked steps crumble underfoot. On the top floor, open the hatch in the ceiling.
somnium.dream.mirror_room.objective: Wait for your reflection to break the glass, kill it, then step into the light.
somnium.dream.subtitle: ...you drift into a dream
somnium.outcome.survived_timeout: The dream fades on its own
somnium.outcome.died_in_dream: You died in the dream... and woke in a cold sweat
somnium.dream.interrupted: The dream was cut short. You're back in your bed with all your things.
somnium.dream.essence_reward: You wake up clutching Nightmare Essence.
somnium.dream.boundary: The dream will not let you go any further...
somnium.dream.bed_protected: You can't break this bed. Someone is sleeping in it!
somnium.dream.bell_woke: The ringing of a bell woke you up!
somnium.hint.drowning.cathedral: A sunken cathedral rises over the city, and the bell is at the very top. You can get in from any side; inside there's a staircase and a bubble column.
somnium.hint.drowning.pull: The depths are pulling you down!
somnium.hint.drowning.water_high: The water has almost swallowed the city! Hurry to the bell!
somnium.hint.forest.start: Follow the wisps. Don't turn toward the whispers.
somnium.hint.forest.channel_start: Stay in the Beacon Tree's light. It's pulling you out of the dream...
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.start: The wastes are silent. Something is following you.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.appeared: A mirror glints somewhere in the wastes. Touch it three times.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.touch: Touch %s/%s. The mirror slips away... and the footsteps behind you quicken.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.jumped: The mirror dissolves... and glints somewhere else.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.shattered: The mirror shatters and the shards melt into the air.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.grabbed: The Double touches you, and you go cold!
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.direction: The mirror glints somewhere to the %s.
somnium.hint.mine.compass: You have an Exit Compass. It points to the way out.
somnium.hint.feast.rules: Eat fresh dishes. To burn a spoiled one (green name, smoke), hold it in one hand, the lighter in the other, and right-click.
somnium.hint.feast.lighter: The judges hand you a Lighter for burning spoiled dishes.
somnium.hint.feast.dish_taken: You took the dish. Eat it or burn it.
somnium.hint.feast.ignored: The judges quietly take the untouched dish away... They're offended.
somnium.hint.feast.ate_fresh: It was fresh. The judges nod.
somnium.hint.feast.ate_tainted: The dish was spoiled... The judges laugh.
somnium.hint.feast.burned_tainted: The spoiled dish burns. The judges bow their heads.
somnium.hint.feast.burned_fresh: You burned a fresh dish. The judges hiss.
somnium.hint.feast.goblet: The feast is over. Take a Toast Goblet from the table and drink it to wake up.
somnium.hint.feast.goblet_waiting: A Toast Goblet waits on the table.
somnium.hint.feast.golem: The Flesh Golem has awakened and guards the goblets!
somnium.hint.void.start: You're not alone in this dark. Look the Watchers in the eye; your gaze burns them. Catch %s gazes or find the Door of Waking.
somnium.hint.dwd.bed: The bed is still where you fell asleep...
somnium.hint.dwd.fell: You fall into the void... and wake up.
somnium.hint.stairwell.start: A familiar stairwell, except the stairs never end. Flights collapse behind you, and steps ahead sometimes crack. Wait it out or jump over.
somnium.hint.stairwell.keep_moving: Keep moving, the stairs are collapsing.
somnium.hint.stairwell.rotten: A cracked step crumbled under your foot!
somnium.hint.stairwell.fell: You fall into the stairwell... and come to on the steps.
somnium.hint.stairwell.last_floor: The top floor. Above it there's only darkness and the attic hatch.
somnium.hint.stairwell.hatch: Right-click the hatch in the ceiling to leave the dream.
somnium.hint.stairwell.light: Light floods your eyes... you are waking up.
somnium.hint.mirror_room.start: The reflection copies every move you make. For now.
somnium.hint.mirror_room.exit: The reflection is dead! A mirror opened in the wall. Step into the light.
somnium.item.waking_bell.not_dreaming: §7The bell is silent while you're awake. It only works in dreams.
somnium.portal.dissolving: The border of dreams melts beneath your feet...
somnium.portal.arrived: You're in the world of dreams. The portal on the platform will take you home.
somnium.portal.back: You surface from the dream back into reality...
somnium.warning.whispers: §7You hear whispers... you should get some sleep.
somnium.warning.echoes: §6Dreams and the waking world are starting to blur.
advancements.somnium.first_dream.title: First Dream
advancements.somnium.first_dream.descrip: Enter a dream for the first time
subtitles.somnium.exit_portal: A way out of the dream opens
somnium.dream.elevator.objective: Press the floors in the order scratched on the wall. Don't step out until you arrive. If someone gets in on the fifth floor, don't look at her.
somnium.dream.night_train.objective: Walk through every car to the driver's cab and pull the emergency brake. The ticket inspector is behind you, and you don't have a ticket. Maybe there's one on a seat.
somnium.hint.elevator.start: The elevator is on the ground floor. Someone scratched numbers into the wall. Press the floors in order.
somnium.hint.elevator.wrong: Wrong floor. The light flickers, and the numbers on the wall look brighter. You'll have to start over.
somnium.hint.elevator.step_out: You can't get out. The floor pushed you back into the car.
somnium.hint.elevator.she_enters: She stepped in and stands by the door. Don't look at her. Press 1.
somnium.hint.elevator.looked: You looked. She screamed and vanished, and the elevator seems to have forgotten where it was going. Start over.
somnium.hint.elevator.final: The doors open onto white light. Step out.
somnium.hint.train.start: A night train, and you're riding alone. Get to the driver's cab at the front and pull the emergency brake.
somnium.hint.train.controller: A vestibule door slams behind you. "Tickets, please."
somnium.hint.train.ticket: You picked up a ticket. The inspector will punch it once and leave you alone for a while.
somnium.hint.train.punched: The inspector punches your ticket without a word and falls behind.
somnium.hint.train.fined: "No ticket?" You've been marched back a car.
somnium.hint.train.blackout: The lights in the cars go out...
somnium.hint.train.cab: The emergency brake is on the console. Pull the lever.
somnium.hint.train.brake: The brakes shriek and the train grinds to a halt...
somnium.hint.burrower.heard: The burrower heard you. It's blind: sneak (Shift) and it loses your trail.
somnium.dream.backrooms.objective: Find the door marked EXIT. You can hear it from far away. Stay in the light: something smiles in the dark.
somnium.hint.backrooms.start: Yellow rooms, buzzing lights, the smell of damp carpet. Somewhere far off, the exit is humming. Don't stand in the dark.
somnium.haunt.thin.after: He will follow you until you get some sleep.
somnium.warning.thin: §8Someone is standing far away, watching you.
somnium.paralysis.start: You wake in the middle of the night. Your body won't move.
somnium.paralysis.morning_sub: ...it was just a dream, wasn't it?
somnium.command.paralysis_next: %s isn't in bed. The paralysis will start when they lie down.
somnium.hint.mine.shortcut: A wall crumbled behind you. There's a passage there, closer to the exit.
somnium.scare.train.station.1: "Next stop is the last stop. This train goes no further. Ever."
somnium.scare.train.station.2: "Dear passengers, do not leave sleepers unattended."
somnium.event.lifted: Something lifted you by the shoulders.
